name: DeepWiki
description: DeepWiki lets agents read generated documentation for public GitHub repositories and ask questions about their code. It needs no account and no key.

prompts.text: Explain the architecture of the facebook/react repository.
In vercel/next.js, where is the router cache implemented?
List the documentation topics for the tokio-rs/tokio repository.

apps.name: DeepWiki
apps.description: Repository documentation and code questions, over the DeepWiki MCP server with no sign-in.
